full_page.content:
C. 1946
The following is a faithful transcription of handwritten messages on flyleaf of 4 volumes of the "Mystical City of God," by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
THE CORONATION : "What a compendium - Climax at once - of sacred History, of philosphy of every phase of sacred Theology." Fr. S. ofmCap.
THE INCARNATION: "Glory be to God! what a work! What a revelation! What Revelations! What sacred History! What climaxes in philosophy, in every phase of theology! -- as supremely befits its divine Author - no one less than God of the Holy Ghost. see p. 529 Vol IV" Fr. Solanus, ofm Cap.
THE TRANSFIXION: "Blessed be God in all His designs! The following pages recount the sorros of Mary - the Virgin of all blessed virgins"
THE CONCEPTION: "Blessed be God in all His design! This "The Mystical City of God.," in my conviction is the real life of the Blessed Mother of God - Mary Immaculate ever Virgin - Queen of the Universe. If full resuls are to be expected the reader will do well to pray to the Holy Gost at least briefly and humbly before each reading - as is becomingly done at the reading of other "inspired works." Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Volumes are possession of:
W. J. Tiger
1230 W. Washington
For Wayne, Indiana
